headline: Executive order lets the head of a federal development finance agency use certain Defense Production Act powers to respond to COVID-19.
what_it_does: This order hands some of the President's powers under the Defense Production Act to the chief executive of the U.S. International Development Finance Corporation. The stated purpose is to respond to the COVID-19 outbreak. The title does not say exactly which powers are delegated or how they would be used.

who_it_affects.how: Its chief executive gains authority under the Defense Production Act to act on the COVID-19 response.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses that make supplies needed for the COVID-19 response
who_it_affects.how: They may be affected if the agency uses its new authority, but the title gives no details on how.

when_it_takes_effect: 2020-05-14 (date signed; exact effective date not stated in source)
